mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.15%) signals accommodative monetary policy that compresses discount rates and elevates equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.15%.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points (UNRATE > 5.6% + 0.3pp) indicates labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE increases by >0.3pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST < 1020) and retail sales (RSAFS < 440000) over 2 months signal a sharp demand contraction that triggers equity sell-offs, predicting negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS over 2 months fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases (20-day returns positive >55% of instances).

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 105.0) during late-cycle expansion phases indicates manufacturing supply chain stress that reduces corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO below 105.0 in late-cycle expansion fails to predict negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%) signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained non-farm payrolls growth above 100,000 per month (PAYEMS > 140000) indicates robust labor market expansion that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 100,000.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in housing starts (HOUST > 1030) and retail sales (RSAFS > 445000) over 2 months signal strong consumer demand that elevates corporate revenue expectations, predicting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS over 2 months fails to predict positive returns in more than 55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained industrial production growth above 106.0 (INDPRO > 106.0) indicates robust manufacturing output that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO remains above 106.0.
